reviews.text:
We recently moved to McKinney, TX from Florida, where we had a pool, so having one was important to us—especially for Texas summers and family gatherings. We found the perfect house; however, it didn’t have a pool.

We reviewed ideas and proposals from several pool companies and ultimately selected Hobert. While their pricing was competitive, the deciding factor was how much we enjoyed working with Chris Notley. From the very beginning, Chris was attentive, listened carefully to what we wanted, and remained flexible throughout the process. He offered multiple design options and helped guide us to the right choice.

Once we decided to move forward, Chris set clear expectations, and the project stayed on track. Our pool was completed within three months, and the final result looks fantastic. We’re really looking forward to spring when we can start enjoying the pool and hosting family gatherings.
reviews.author: Terry Rayner

reviews.text: Hobert Pools & Spas in McLendon-Chisholm provided an excellent experience from design through completion. Chris created an outstanding pool design that thoughtfully incorporated space for an above-ground spa and a future outdoor kitchen, maximizing both functionality and layout. Steve, the Project Manager, ensured the project remained on schedule and that each phase was completed efficiently and professionally. The entire process reflected strong communication, attention to detail, and a high standard of workmanship. I would confidently recommend Hobert Pools & Spas to anyone seeking a well-designed, professionally managed pool installation.
reviews.author: Ron Lewis

reviews.author: Terri Acton

reviews.text:
There’s a reason Hobert Pools has been around since 1975 — their quality of work, professional staff, and attention to detail at every step of the process are unmatched. I cannot speak highly enough about the finished product and how thrilled we are with it.

Our salesperson, Ryan Rees, guided us from the very beginning toward our dream pool. He stayed in constant communication, never pressured us, and patiently reviewed multiple designs until we found exactly what we wanted.

Their project managers were equally outstanding — always responsive, thorough, and professional. A special thank-you to Tony for his patience and support throughout the entire project. You answered every question and gave us peace of mind from start to finish.

If you’re looking for a company that delivers top-notch quality and the pool of your dreams, look no further than Hobert Pools.

Thank you!
Shawn & Denarie Garris
reviews.author: denarie garris

reviews.text:
Update as of 7/15/25

Hobert contacted me after seeing the review and contacted me. They offered to come out and revisit the pool deck. They did in a timely manner, offered to refinish the entire patio with a coating. I really am happy with the final results. Much better and I am thankful they took the time to take care of this. I am updating the star review as well.

Bad experience overall. There are a lot of builders out there and I’m sure all will have some sort of issue at some point. Biggest issue is I not only have cracking patio concrete which Hobert will say is ground movement, but the concrete is flaking. I’ve had a few concrete people out to look at it and everyone has said this was a bad pour. From the mix to quality of the mix to the quality of the sub Hobert uses. Good luck to those that use Hobert, you’re about to drop a lot of money on substandard materials and workmanship.
reviews.author: Corey

reviews.text: I would highly recommend Hobert pools for your pool building needs!!!! I did get other quotes from other pool companies or tried to at least. Other companies either did not show or just flaked. I made an appointment for a consultation and Chris Michaels showed up. He was on time and very nice and thoroughly explained the entire process. He was not pushy at all and he answered every question I had and I had a lot. He really went above and beyond!! I would highly recommend him!! As far as the pool building process it was amazing and very fast!!! They started September 4th and my project was completed Nov. 3!! Each phase of the project was explained in detail!!!! Every time they said contractors were coming they came at 7 am sharp and were done by noon!!! They never left a mess always cleaned up. The quality of all materials used is AMAZING!!! If I could give 10 stars I absolutely would!!! Hobert Pools and its employees are amazing and really go the extra mile to satisfy their customers. Huge thanks to everyone involved in my project!!! So so so happy!!!!!!

data.summary: Reviews appear overwhelmingly authentic. The company has a long history (since 1975) and receives detailed, passionate reviews from satisfied customers. Negative reviews highlight specific, credible issues common in pool construction (soil shift, communication gaps). The primary concern is a pattern of post-construction decking problems mentioned in a detailed 1-star review. The presence of two identical positive reviews is a minor anomaly but not sufficient to indicate widespread fakery given the volume and specificity of other reviews.
fake_signals: Two identical 5-star reviews posted on Google Local and HQ within 4 weeks (Terry Rayner/Ron Lewis)
Some reviews on HQ are anonymous, limiting profile verification

negative_evidence: Detailed complaint about decking issues 5 years post-installation with no mention of resolution
Complaint about sales rep ghosting after contract suggests poor follow-through
positive_evidence: Company proactively contacted a reviewer (Corey) and refinishing the entire patio coating
Negative review mentions initial good product, implying expectation of durability

authentic_signals: Specific details: employee names (Chris, Tony, Steve, Angela, Ryan, Dean), project timelines (2 months, 8 weeks), project types (spa, outdoor kitchen, overlay)
Varied writing styles and emotional authenticity
Mix of praise and constructive feedback in mid-range reviews
Negative reviews contain specific, credible details (Travertine paver issues, $100k project, dates)
complaint_patterns: Poor communication/sales rep ghosting after contract
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistent across platforms. Google (4.3) and Yelp (3.9) are reasonably close, with Yelp typically being more critical. The Houzz rating (3.7) aligns with this pattern. No major red flags.
